mechanics_notes.text: The Double-Edge Sickle is unlocked on the 1st page of the Servants of Freedom Premium Warbond for 35 Medals.
The LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle is a LAS-16 Sickle with all overheating protections conveniently removed, expelling excess heat to the user.
0-25% heat: Laser pulses are Light armor penetrating and deal 60 damage.
26-50% heat: Laser pulses are Medium armor penetrating and deal 55 damage.
Deals 10 heat damage per second to the user.
51-90% heat: Laser pulses are Medium armor penetrating and deal 70 damage.
Deals 20 heat damage a second to the user.
91%+ heat: Laser pulses are Heavy armor penetrating and deal 70 damage.

The VG-70 Variable, as its name suggests, is a weapon system with variable firing modes and rpm options.
Auto: Fully-automatic with three available rpm options; 300, 550 & 750.
Volley: Fires one round from each barrel simultaneously, totaling 7 rounds on target with one trigger pull.
Total: Fires all remaining ammunition in the magazine.

mechanics_notes.text: The Laser Cannon is unlocked at the Patriotic Administration Center (Engineering Bay subsection) for 4000 Requisition Slips at Level 5.
Rather than using magazines of ammunition, the Laser Cannon builds up heat in its Internal Cooling Element while it is firing.
If too much heat is built up in the ICE, it will burn out and render the weapon unable to fire until the heat sink is replaced via a reload.
From a nearly maximum heat ICE, the weapon will require 15 seconds to fully cool down under standard conditions.
Finally, when firing the Laser Cannon for the first time after a period of inactivity, it requires a short "warm-up" period where the weapon has to be charged before discharging its beam.

Rather than immediately firing the weapon when the trigger is pressed, holding it down begins a charging cycle that requires 3.0 seconds to complete.
If the trigger is released before charging is complete, all built-up charge is immediately dissipated and the weapon must start the process over.
After firing, the weapon immediately overheats and cannot be fired again for 15.0 seconds, which is affected by weather modifiers.

mechanics_notes.text: The PLAS-45 Epoch is unlocked on the 1st page of the Control Group Premium Warbond for 75 Medals.
The Epoch holds 4 magazines by default, each containing 3 shots, which must be reloaded while stationary.
Like the RS-422 Railgun, the Epoch must be charged before it can fire, risking the death of the user and destruction of the weapon if that charge is held for too long.
The armor penetration only scales up to Anti-Tank I armor penetration when overcharged; this state additionally grants the weapon +100% bonus projectile and +60% explosion damage.
The following are recognizable indicators to know the fully charged state of the weapon:
The charge meter that can be seen either under the sight in first-person or at the back of the gun in third-person.
This meter enters the red zone when the gun is overcharged.
The muzzle flash that occurs only when the weapon reaches its overcharged state.

mechanics_notes.text: The Railgun is unlocked at the Patriotic Administration Center for 10000 Requisition Slips at Level 20.
The Railgun fires projectiles using a charge-based mechanic, and primarily has two firing modes, Safe and Unsafe.
In Safe Mode, holding down the trigger builds up charge in the weapon and quickly readies a shot.
While the charge is safely held at 60%, the player's movement is greatly reduced and releasing the trigger will immediately fire the projectile, dealing a high amount of damage.
There is no inherent danger in holding a charge in Safe Mode besides the reduced movement speed, so the wielder may charge the weapon for as long as they desire.
In Unsafe Mode, holding down the trigger will overcharge the weapon, increasing the projectile's damage the longer the trigger is held.
As with Safe Mode, movement speed is reduced for as long as charge is building up, and releasing the trigger immediately fires the weapon.
Charging the weapon in Unsafe Mode can increase the additional damage dealt by up to 150%, causing the projectile to inflict up to 2.5 times the damage it would have in Safe Mode.

mechanics_notes.text: The S-11 Speargun is unlocked on the 2nd page of the Dust Devils Premium Warbond for 85 Medals.
The weapon is comparable to a RS-422 Railgun that has been set to Safe mode; however, a few quirks set it apart.
The Speargun fires instantly, no charge-up required.
However, it has significantly fewer reserves, a longer reload time, and much higher projectile drag.
The spears can be shot at the ground to release gas and prevent the advancement of enemies much like G-4 Gas Grenades.
The projectile and explosion both have a demolition force of 30, allowing it to destroy spawners such as Bug Holes, Fabricators and Grounded Warp Ships as well as PoI containers and Lightning Spires.

mechanics_notes.text: The RL-77 has two firing modes: Flak and Cluster.
Flak Mode uses a proximity fuse that detonates 0.2 s after the rocket detects a target or obstacle within 2 m.
It has a 1.5 s lifetime fuse or maximum range of 375 m.
The bomblets have random time fuses lasting no more than 0.7 s.
The minimum safe distance is ~30 m from the center of the explosion cluster in Flak mode.
The timed fuses of the bomblets mean it may not damage everything below if it disperses too high up.
Cluster Mode utilizes an impact fuse rocket with a 0.25 s lifetime and a maximum range of 62.5 m.
The maximum dispersion radius of a Cluster mode rocket on level ground is 60 meters if fired straight upwards.

mechanics_notes.text: The Supply Pack is unlocked at the Patriotic Administration Center (in the Engineering Bay subsection) for 4000 Requisition Slips at Level 1.
When called in, the Supply Pack arrives fully stocked with four resupply boxes.
Each of these functions the same as a resupply box from the Resupply stratagem, though it does not benefit from the Superior Packing Methodology ship module upgrade.
The Supply Pack can only be refilled by picking up a supply box from the Resupply stratagem.
One Resupply box will refill one box on the Supply Pack, regardless of whether or not the Superior Packing Methodology upgrade has been unlocked.
Stray Ammo Boxes, Grenade Cases, and Stim Crates found within a mission cannot refill the Supply Pack.
Refilling the Supply Pack will also refill the wearer's other supplies as normal.

If it is orange (56% - 85% energy), warping will cause damage.

If it is red (<56% energy), warping will kill the Helldiver, regardless of any armor passives or other modifiers.
